responsibility: This file implements late RTL resource and liveness analysis used mainly by delay-slot reorganization. It computes the registers, condition codes, and memory resources referenced or set by insns, tracks live hard registers at branch targets and fallthrough points with a target hash cache keyed by insn UID and basic-block generation ticks, and initializes special resource requirements at the function end and epilogue boundary. Its responsibility is resource accounting and target-live-register discovery for reorg-style passes, not general-purpose dataflow for the whole backend.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable implementation behind resource.h, including late RTL resource marking, branch-target live-register discovery, cached target-info tables, and init/free support; the header just defines the resources data structure, enums, and exported function declarations.
